cohort: The study included 410 neonates diagnosed with neural tube defects in two public hospitals in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, whose medical charts were reviewed from 2018 to 2022.
finding: The overall incidence rate of mortality was 8.54 per 1000 neonate days with a median survival time of 25 days, and being preterm, low birth weight, encephalocele, cervical and occipital lesion level, presence of hydrocephalus, and Chiari-II malformation were significant predictors of time to death.
